about: data.police.uk is the UK's open police data API. This CLI covers forces and senior officers, street-level crimes and outcomes, neighbourhood teams, events and priorities, stop and search records, data availability dates, and the custom CSV download form.

commands.summary: List all police forces (id and name). Use the id in other commands.
Get one police force's details: website, phone number and engagement channels such as social media.
List the senior officers of a police force, with rank and bio.
List the crime categories (url slug and name) that were valid for a given month.

params.name: date
params.description: Month in YYYY-MM format. Omit for the latest month.

commands.summary: List the months that have street-level data available, and which forces published stop and search data for each month.
Get the date the crime data was last updated (this is the latest month available).
Street-level crimes for one month, either within a 1-mile radius of a lat/lng point or inside a custom polygon. Can be limited to one category.

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of the centre point. Use with lng; do not combine with poly.

params.name: lng
params.description: Longitude of the centre point. Use with lat.

params.name: poly
params.description: Polygon as lat,lng pairs separated by colons, e.g. 52.268,0.543:52.794,0.238:52.130,0.478. Use instead of lat/lng.

params.name: date
params.description: Month in YYYY-MM format. Omit for the latest month.

commands.summary: Crimes recorded at the anonymised location nearest to a lat/lng point, or at a specific street location id, for one month.

params.name: location_id
params.description: Street location id (location.street.id from crime results). Use instead of lat/lng.

commands.summary: Crimes a force recorded in one month that could not be mapped to a location.

params.name: date
params.description: Month in YYYY-MM format. Omit for the latest month.

commands.summary: Case outcomes recorded in one month near a lat/lng point, at a street location id, or inside a polygon. Each outcome includes the crime it relates to.

params.name: location_id
params.description: Street location id. Use instead of lat/lng.

params.name: poly
params.description: Polygon as lat,lng:lat,lng:... Use instead of lat/lng.

commands.summary: Get the full outcome history of one crime, looked up by its persistent_id.

params.name: persistent_id
params.description: 64-character persistent_id from crime results. Anti-social behaviour crimes have no persistent_id.

commands.summary: List the neighbourhood policing areas (id and name) of a force.
Get one neighbourhood's details: name, centre point, description, links and contact details.

params.name: neighbourhood
params.description: Neighbourhood id from list-neighbourhoods or locate-neighbourhood

commands.summary: Get a neighbourhood's boundary as a list of lat/lng points. These can be joined as lat,lng:lat,lng for the poly param of other commands.
List the officers and PCSOs on a neighbourhood's policing team.
List upcoming events for a neighbourhood, such as police drop-ins and community meetings.
List a neighbourhood's policing priorities: each issue and the action taken on it.
Find which force and neighbourhood cover a lat,lng point.
Stop and searches in one month within a 1-mile radius of a lat/lng point, or inside a polygon.

params.name: poly
params.description: Polygon as lat,lng:lat,lng:... Use instead of lat/lng.

params.name: date
params.description: Month in YYYY-MM format. Omit for the latest month.

commands.summary: All stop and searches a force reported for one month.

params.name: force
params.description: Force id. See list-dates for which forces published stop and search data in which months.

params.name: date
params.description: Month in YYYY-MM format. Omit for the latest month.

commands.summary: Stop and searches a force reported for one month that could not be mapped to a location.

params.name: date
params.description: Month in YYYY-MM format. Omit for the latest month.

commands.summary: Stop and searches at a specific street location id for one month.

params.name: location_id
params.description: Street location id (location.street.id from stops-street or crime results)

params.name: date
params.description: Month in YYYY-MM format. Omit for the latest month.
